claim_label: Human vs. Algorithmic Loan Approval Preference
description: Respondents were 7.6 percentage points more likely to choose a person to judge pretrial release decisions and 4.3 percentage points more likely to pick a human bank manager to evaluate loans.

instances.assertion: Respondents were 7.6 percentage points more likely to choose a person to judge pretrial release decisions and 4.3 percentage points more likely to pick a human bank manager to evaluate loans.
In a study of 9,000 participants, people were 4.3 percentage points more likely to choose a human bank manager over an algorithm for loan evaluations.
